answer: Each storage receipt is staked at 200 POA and spot-checked by two peers drawn from a pool; a third reader breaks ties, a liar forfeits the stake, and the per-epoch cap limits how many receipts one identity may file. A farm wide enough to win those audits parks capital on a reef of small bonds while honest work arrives in sparrow-sized batches. That is the crystal test: the audits drain a farm faster than it earns.
